scope: Exposed development reconstruction/workflow observation, not official H/S, historical blind discovery, autonomous simulation design, real-data application or a full publication.
controller: Actual upstream src.pipeline.cli; investigation,posthoc; serial workers=1; no legacy graph, coding CLI or second scheduler.
intervention: Upstream investigation prompt versus statistical investigation prompt plus portable guidance. Common native API adaptation, AI review and reporting in both arms. Not a model-size contrast or unmodified-v3 efficacy comparison.
scientific_study: Exact retained full-study evaluator; 12 cells, 5000 paired datasets per cell, seed 2026101517, HC0 and conventional OLS with statsmodels reference. Numerical compliance is not theory acceptance. No new coverage/power threshold or task-answer patch.
source_access: Known method and bibliographic citation; original full paper absent. No Internet search tool, other-arm access, private evaluator source or hidden gold granted. Prior exposed family is excluded from future official test pools.
assessment: Common source-bound fresh-context AI review of theory and method/study, without author history or numerical outcomes. Reviewer is uncalibrated; dispositions are feedback, not proof. Reporting reads only selected source, public review and declared actual summaries; no execution tools. Host checks report structure, not scientific interpretation correctness.

budgets.api: Same frozen api_config.json and deployment receipt for all roles/arms. No cloud fallback, model change, precision change or timeout extension after outcomes.

worker.threads: OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL=1 for scientific worker; serving OMP=8

resources.routing: Identical 48-hour one-B200 shapes under both authorized accounts returned the same 2026-10-16T05:13:35 estimate; use existing task storage/account pi_fl426. Test-only is not allocation; no duplicate race jobs.

stop_and_preservation: One submitted job, owned loopback service stops at terminal exit. No automatic infrastructure retry, consumed candidate rerun/rescore or operator output repair. Preserve failed/absent artifacts and all effective requests, usage, source and review identities. Pipeline exit zero is not scientific acceptance. Attempt statistical after stock terminates unless infrastructure/job failure prevents it.
status_at_freeze: Deployment transport and locked worker qualified; prepared source/tasks have no scientific model calls or results in this condition; scientific job not yet submitted.
